name: AgentStatus
summary: The state of an agent, in one fixed vocabulary.

a11y.apg: none — it is text with a decorative dot, exactly like Status

props.name: state
props.description: The six states come measured from the reference, not invented here. Each maps to a Status variant instead of a loose colour: the reference writes `text-yellow-500` inside the component, and colour inside a component is what this design system forbids.

props.name: label
props.description: Overrides the built-in wording. The default is translated; replace it when your domain calls the state something else.
